title: Vibrant Swirling Abstraction
description: An abstract painting featuring dynamic, concentric circular forms and flowing, ribbon-like brushstrokes that twist and spiral across the canvas. The composition uses thick, energetic strokes in a rainbow of colors against a white background.
prompt: abstract painting with thick energetic brushstrokes forming concentric circles and flowing ribbon shapes that spiral and intertwine across the canvas, vibrant rainbow color palette including deep blue, magenta, bright yellow, cyan and red swirling together, high contrast against a clean white background, expressive and dynamic composition with visible texture and movement
